description:
The image features a black television monitor partially submerged in a stream, with the screen facing the viewer. The TV is situated in the center of the image, positioned in the middle of the stream.

The stream's water is murky and fast-moving, with a few plant shoots visible in the foreground. In the background, a grassy bank rises to meet a cloudy sky.

The overall ambiance of the image is one of abandonment and neglect, as the TV appears to have been discarded or lost in the stream
